name: PagerDuty
summary: PagerDuty's free plan covers 5 users, 1 on-call schedule and 1 escalation policy. Professional costs $21 per user a month on annual billing or $25 monthly, and a separate platform tier starts at $2,800 a year and requires payment upfront.

facts.text: The free plan allows 5 users per escalation level and keeps 3 months of historical data, and it does not include postmortems.
Professional includes one custom postmortem template, while AI-generated post-incident reviews need the PagerDuty Advance add-on.
PagerDuty's pricing page shows no price for the AIOps, Status Pages, Runbook Automation or Live Call Routing add-ons.
PagerDuty states that it completed SOC 2 Type II examinations and holds ISO 27001 certification.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 5 users, 1 on-call schedule, 1 escalation policy, 100 SMS or phone notifications a month

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Billed annually; $25 on monthly billing. Includes single sign-on through Google or SAML

plans.name: Platform Starter
plans.notes: 5 seats (5 more as a limited-time bonus), 5,000 Signal Intelligence events, payment upfront

hiddenCosts: AIOps, Status Pages, Runbook Automation and Live Call Routing are add-ons with no published price.
The platform tiers are billed yearly only, with payment required upfront.
